title: The street crowds' talk scripts: res/field/castelia_rush/talk_scripts.json
description: The scripts of the passers-by who stop to talk to the player, by object code (CasteliaRushScripts in src/ov121/castelia_rush.c, the last file of archive a/1/8/3), shared by every zone. Passerby_Init gives a passer-by one of its object code's six scripts at random; an object code that isn't listed gets none. tools/data/castelia_rush_data.py packs it.

obj_codes.description: The object codes and their scripts; the first entry of an object code wins

scripts.description: Six script IDs (the global scripts 10350 to 10377 of res/field/scripts/global_10350.s), one picked at random
